name: Banijay Group N.V.
summary: Banijay Group N.V. operates extensively throughout Europe, engaging in a dual business model that encompasses both the creation and dissemination of media content, alongside the provision of online sports betting and gaming services. The company is responsible for producing a diverse range of programming, including both fictionalized and unscripted material. This broad portfolio covers popular categories such as reality television, entertainment and talk shows, competitive game formats, informative factual entertainment, compelling documentaries, serialized dramas, animated features, and comedic productions. Furthermore, Banijay Group N.V. manages its own internet-based platforms dedicated to sports wagering. Established in 1994 and headquartered in Paris, France, the entity underwent a corporate rebranding in May 2024, changing its name from FL Entertainment N.V. to its current designation.
